question: How do I activate an eSIM?
answer: Use the QR code or activation code NovaCell sends you. On iPhone go to Settings > Mobile Data > Add eSIM; on Android go to Settings > Network & Internet > SIMs > Download a SIM. Stay connected to Wi-Fi while the profile downloads. Each eSIM QR code can be used only once, so if a scan fails do not keep retrying the same code - ask for a fresh activation code through live chat in the MyTelecom app or by calling 611.

question: Can I use an eSIM and a physical SIM at the same time?
answer: Yes, on phones that support it. An eSIM can hold more than one profile, so you can keep your NovaCell line on one SIM and use a second line or a local SIM on the other, for example while travelling. Check that your phone supports dual SIM with eSIM before you start.

question: What should I do before travelling abroad?
answer: 1) Turn on International Roaming in MyTelecom > Plan & Services > International Roaming at least 24 hours before you travel. 2) Add a roaming pass before you use your phone abroad so you are not charged standard roaming rates. 3) Set Settings > Mobile Network > Network Selection to Automatic. 4) Check the coverage map to confirm your destination is covered.

question: I bought a roaming bundle but was still charged roaming fees. Why?
answer: Usage abroad before the bundle was activated is charged at standard roaming rates, and those charges are not reversed when the bundle starts later the same day. Your itemised bill (Billing > Itemised Bill in the app) shows the time the bundle was activated and the time of your first usage abroad. If you believe the bundle was active before that usage, contact support on 611 so an agent can review it.
